parsed_json.up: Select compound ChEMBL identifier, canonical SMILES, standard type, standard value, and standard units for the first 500 activity measurements against target CHEMBL206. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary, filtering by target ChEMBL ID. Require compound structures via INNER JOIN on compound_structures. Rank rows by potency (ascending standard_value) and limit to 500. Do not deduplicate; return all qualifying activity rows.
